art: Eight transparent 1254-square single-frame idle sprites; south reuses the completed front idle. Generated with built-in image_gen. Native images visually inspected for orientation, rear costume, hand/foot silhouette and margins.
registration: Original PNG pixels preserved; importer pixels-per-unit matches visible height of the existing south walk frame. Foot baseline registered as sprite pivot.
runtime: Eight walk-to-idle transitions, teleport handling, disable/re-enable and sprite ownership verified. Existing movement clips and movement frame references retained.
motion: Single stationary frame per direction, with authored looping idle clips. No multi-frame breathing motion requested or added.
